raw_text: Thread on the deepfake Bollywood endorsement video circulating in India. I've done frame-by-frame analysis and the face-swap artifacts are clearly visible at 0.5x speed. The lighting direction on the face is approximately 40 degrees off from the ambient scene lighting. This is a textbook case of political deepfake deployed at scale during an election cycle. Indian Election Commission should mandate deepfake detection tools.
